first-use: Shared setup that other smokes import; it checks nothing itself.
f4-deliverables: Runs download-port and the remote smokes together, for a release check.
download-port: Stops at its retry check on Electron 44 (the file it looks for has already moved); needs its own fix before CI.
remote-permissions: Permission requests time out in a hidden window on Electron 44; needs its own fix before CI.
m2-deliverables: Ends every provider process on the machine by name, so it runs only with no VUA open.
